# Tokenary and Big Wallet

> Tokenary is an open-source Safari crypto wallet that evolved into Big Wallet.

Big Wallet for Safari is available on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision.
Its Safari extension connects wallets to compatible websites offering MetaMask
or Phantom connections. Supported networks include Ethereum, Solana, Base,
Polygon, Binance Smart Chain, Optimism, Arbitrum, and Avalanche. Big Wallet uses
Apple Keychain for wallet storage.

## Products and support

- [Tokenary website](https://tokenary.io/): Tokenary's Safari wallet overview and announcement of its evolution into Big Wallet.
- [Big Wallet on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6478607925): Download Big Wallet and check current availability and device requirements.
- [Big Wallet support](https://help.lil.org/): Support link from Big Wallet's App Store metadata.

## Sources

- [Big Wallet source code](https://github.com/lil-org/big-wallet): Public source repository.
- [English App Store name and subtitle](https://github.com/lil-org/big-wallet/blob/main/app-store-connect/localizations/app-info/en-US.strings): Product naming metadata.
- [English App Store description](https://github.com/lil-org/big-wallet/blob/main/app-store-connect/localizations/version/en-US.strings): Product capabilities and support metadata.
